notationPrinciple.literalGerman: Ebenso sind die doppelten Notenreihen auf einem Liniensystem nur als zwei verschiedene Weisen zu betrachten, wenn sie nicht mit „Chor“ bezeichnet sind.
notationPrinciple.english: Two note lines on a single staff are to be treated as two different melodies unless marked Chor.
notationPrinciple.application: Preserve coherent upper/lower alternatives in the second printed setting; common heads reconverge, and no alternatives are sounded as chords. Independent musical review remains pending.

figures.contextPending: Pickup rest/eighth plus two subsequent quarter beats as printed; do not pad to a full common-time bar.

figures.name: r’wi-a · Revia
figures.contextPending: The lower G4 eighth is a distinct head from the upper G4 sixteenth; common F4/E4/D4 heads retain their positions. Both coherent alternatives are monophonic.

figures.name: Poser · Pazer
figures.contextPending: The two lower-stem C5/A4 heads replace upper E5/D5 at those positions. Both routes reconverge on the common C5 eighth before the bar; do not omit that common note or combine the alternatives.

figures.name: T’lischo k’ta-noh
figures.contextPending: Unlike the first setting, this row has no small grace group; retain both dotted quarters and all five opening attacks.

printedDitto.scope: The initial source passage is marked dto; the tail is separately written.

figures.name: Kadmo → w’aslo
figures.contextPending: Four rapid notes have three beams (32nds), without a tuplet numeral. Each of the four doubled positions has a coherent upper/lower route; no chord or source B-natural from the different first setting is transferred.

figures.name: Dargo → t’wir
figures.contextPending: The written D4 sixteenth before the bar is not the following D4 eighth. The ending is three eighths and a quarter, not the first setting’s quarter/sixteenths/eighth.

printedDitto.scope: After the written first component, dto refers to the middle passage; the final pickup and ending are separately written.

figures.name: Mercho → tipcho → sof po-suk · printed ending
figures.contextPending: Preserve the two interior eighth rests, both repeated F4 eighths around the final bar and the final eighth rest; do not inherit the first setting’s different ending or pad a bar.
